name: bind
meaning: timeless definition; implicit genesis of later << and <<<

name: recur
meaning: continuous state: h << f asserts dh/dt = f

name: evolve
meaning: structural evolution on a slow timescale

name: actuate
meaning: boundary condition on an effector manifold

name: assembly
meaning: declare an open hypergraph with named ports

name: obligation
meaning: compile-time proof obligation, erased after discharge

name: export
meaning: expose a port from an assembly

name: guard
meaning: value defined only where the predicate holds

name: contract
meaning: sum over the named axis; all other axes must align

name: fuse
meaning: topological union of hypergraphs sharing ports

name: gradient
meaning: reverse-mode query over the cotangent bundle

name: select
meaning: rank selection over an axis; replaces branching

name: surrogate
meaning: attach pseudo-derivative to a non-differentiable event

name: pairing
meaning: the only legal Tan/Cot combination; yields energy

name: concatenate
meaning: join on an axis; never implicit

name: adjoint
meaning: f ~~ f_adj declares an analytic adjoint

name: reindex
meaning: A >>[a] f changes layout/label along a
